name: probarion
description: Probarion CLI: dry-run spends, verify a vault's ledger, anchors, attestation records and keys, audit any NEAR account's access keys and code, prove a transaction's outcomes with light_client_proof, print the owner and approver transactions of a vault for near-cli-rs to sign, and generate ed25519 keys.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if(process.env.CI!=='true'||process.env.GITHUB_WORKFLOW!=='release'){console.error('Refusing to publish: only the GitHub release workflow publishes. Push a tag such as sdk-v0.1.0 instead.');process.exit(1)}"
